data.name: Main.Status
data.value: {0} of {1} PCs online · this console: {2} · port {3}

data.name: Lab.SelectionHint
data.value: Click a PC to select it. Hold ⌘ (Ctrl on Windows) and click to add or remove PCs one by one, or use Select all. Drag a tile to rearrange the room.

data.name: Lab.Empty
data.value: No PCs yet. Write a USB payload in Settings, run the installer (or FakeAgent) on the PCs, then press Enrol PCs and type the passphrase once — the PCs enrol themselves and appear here.

data.name: Machine.RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove {0} from the lab? Its certificate is revoked at the same time, so it cannot come back on its own. A reinstalled PC enrols again with a code from the current USB stick.

data.name: Machine.RemoveManyConfirm
data.value: Remove {0} PCs from the lab ({1})? Their certificates are revoked at the same time, so they cannot come back on their own. Reinstalled PCs enrol again with codes from the current USB stick.

data.name: Revoke.MachineConfirm
data.value: Revoke the certificate of {0}? The PC will be refused by every console of this lab from now on and needs Setup.exe --rekey to come back.

data.name: Revoke.RemovedReason
data.value: {0} removed from the lab by the teacher

data.name: Revoke.InstanceConfirm
data.value: Revoke the console "{0}"? It will stop working until someone imports the backup on it again. Do this for a stolen or lost machine only — a colleague's console that simply exists does not need revoking.

data.name: Unlock.Wrong
data.value: That does not open the lab key. Try again, or use the recovery code.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonEnrol
data.value: Enrolling PCs and renewing their certificates need the lab key. It stays unlocked for 15 minutes after you last use it, or until you lock it.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonRenewal
data.value: Some PCs need their certificates renewed. Unlock the lab key and they will renew on their own within a minute.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonSettings
data.value: This setting changes the lab key.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonHolders
data.value: Adding or removing a key holder needs the lab key.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonRecovery
data.value: Printing a new recovery code needs the lab key.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonBackup
data.value: Exporting a backup needs the lab key.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonRemove
data.value: Removing a PC revokes its certificate, and that needs the lab key.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonRevoke
data.value: Revoking a certificate needs the lab key.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonResume
data.value: Setup was not finished on this computer: the recovery code or the backup is still missing. Unlock the lab key to finish it now.

data.name: Unlock.ReasonRemint
data.value: This console's own certificate is about to expire. Unlock the lab key once to renew it; cancel to keep the current one for now.

data.name: Key.UnlockedUntil
data.value: Lab key unlocked — locks itself at {0}

data.name: Key.UnlockHint
data.value: The passphrase is needed only to enrol PCs, renew certificates, revoke, add holders and export backups. Daily use never asks for it.

data.name: Key.AddHolderHint
data.value: A colleague who can open the lab with their own passphrase — so an exam is not stopped by one teacher being ill.

data.name: Key.RemoveHolderConfirm
data.value: Remove "{0}" as a key holder? Their passphrase will no longer open this lab. Export a new backup afterwards.

data.name: Key.HoldersHint
data.value: Every holder is equal. The last one cannot be removed.

data.name: Key.ReprintConfirm
data.value: Print a new recovery code? The old one stops working the moment the key is saved. Export a new backup afterwards.

data.name: Key.RecoveryReprinted
data.value: A new recovery code was printed; the old one is void.

data.name: Settings.EndpointHint
data.value: The address and port come from the command line (--bind, --port); the beacon tells the PCs where to connect, so they follow a change by themselves.

data.name: Settings.TeacherMachinesHint
data.value: Consoles of this lab seen beaconing or reported by PCs. Revoke one only if it was stolen or lost.

data.name: Backup.Stale
data.value: The lab changed since the last backup: a key holder, the recovery code, or a USB stick was written. Export a new backup, or a replacement console will not know about it.

data.name: Backup.Missing
data.value: No backup has been exported from this console yet.

data.name: Backup.Hint
data.value: The backup is the one file that moves the lab to another computer. It opens with any holder's passphrase or the recovery code and is useless without them.

data.name: Banner.OtherConsole
data.value: {0} is also running this lab and holds {1} of {2} PCs ({3}).

data.name: Banner.TookOver
data.value: {0} took over the lab at {1} and holds {2} of {3} PCs ({4}).

data.name: Banner.Renewal
data.value: {0} certificate(s) need renewing — unlock the lab key and the PCs will renew by themselves.

data.name: Banner.BackupMissing
data.value: No backup yet. Without one, losing this computer means reinstalling every PC.

data.name: Banner.BackupStale
data.value: The lab key or the enrollment codes changed since the last backup. Export a new one.

data.name: Enroll.PayloadWritten
data.value: USB payload written to {0}. Point FakeAgent --payload (or the installer) at it.

data.name: Enroll.HintFormat
data.value: Writes ca.crt and setup.json with {0} single-use codes ({1} PCs + {2} spares) into a LabControl folder. The stick carries no secret.

data.name: Enroll.VoidEarlier
data.value: Void the {0} unused code(s) of earlier sticks — this stick replaces them

data.name: Enroll.VoidHintOn
data.value: The {0} unused code(s) written earlier will stop working. Untick this if PCs were already installed from an earlier stick but have not enrolled yet — otherwise they will have to be reinstalled.

data.name: Enroll.VoidHintOff
data.value: The {0} unused code(s) written earlier stay valid: PCs installed from an earlier stick can still enrol. Void them later by writing another stick with the box ticked.

data.name: Code.Voided
data.value: voided {0} — replaced by a newer stick

data.name: Code.UsedByRemoved
data.value: used by {0} — since removed from the lab

data.name: Script.Hint
data.value: Until M2 the script runs only on simulated PCs: they print the given number of lines and exit with the given code.

data.name: Setup.WelcomeBody
data.value: This computer has no lab yet. Create a new one, or import an existing lab from its backup file to make this computer another console for it.

data.name: Setup.CreateLabHint
data.value: The first time LabControl is used for a room. Creates the lab key and this console.

data.name: Setup.ImportLab
data.value: Import a lab from a backup…

data.name: Setup.ImportLabHint
data.value: A second teacher machine, or a replacement for one that died. Nothing on the student PCs changes.

data.name: Setup.CreateBody
data.value: The lab key is the identity of the room. Choose a passphrase you will remember; a recovery code is shown next in case you do not.

data.name: Setup.PassphraseHint
data.value: At least 8 characters. Needed only for enrolling PCs, renewals, revocations and backups — never for daily use.

data.name: Setup.InstanceNameHint
data.value: How this computer appears to other consoles and in logs, e.g. MacBook or Lab PC.

data.name: Setup.NeedHolderName
data.value: Give the key holder a name.

data.name: Setup.PassphraseTooShort
data.value: The passphrase needs at least 8 characters.

data.name: Setup.RecoveryBody
data.value: This code opens the lab if every passphrase is forgotten. It is shown once. Write it on paper and keep it away from this computer — a wallet, a safe, a drawer at home.

data.name: Setup.AcknowledgeRecovery
data.value: I have written the recovery code down

data.name: Setup.AcknowledgeFirst
data.value: Confirm that you wrote the code down first.

data.name: Setup.BackupBody
data.value: The backup is what moves the lab to another computer. Save it somewhere that survives this computer — a USB stick, a cloud folder. The wizard cannot finish without it.

data.name: Setup.ResumeNote
data.value: Setup was closed last time before it finished. The lab already exists; only the steps below are left, and the console opens right after them.

data.name: Setup.DoneBody
data.value: Next: Settings → Write USB payload, install the PCs with it, then press Enrol PCs.

data.name: Setup.ImportBody
data.value: Pick the backup file, open it with a holder's passphrase or the recovery code, and name this console. The PCs will find it by themselves.

data.name: Setup.BadRecoveryCode
data.value: That is not a recovery code (letters and digits, dashes optional).
